name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel under your shoulders.
Brace your stomach and tuck your hips slightly.
Roll the wheel forward slowly, keeping your back flat.
Stop before your lower back starts to sag.
Pull the wheel back to the start using your stomach.
cues: Only roll as far as you control
Breathe in out, breathe out back

common_mistakes.mistake: Lower back sagging at the far point
common_mistakes.fix: Shorten the roll; stop before the back dips
Keep hips tucked and pull with the stomach
Roll out a short distance and build up slowly
